title: ESA Argonaut mission 1 (long-duration cargo lander)
summary: Best option: land at Peak near Shackleton on 2030-12-04 06:00 UTC (YELLOW, worst case YELLOW). Sunlight 46-70% of the mission, Earth contact 59%, longest darkness 130 h.

landing.shadow_risk: Sun 0.6 deg above the local horizontal at landing: any depression or slope steeper than 0.6 deg facing away from the Sun is in shadow. Craters smaller than about 10 m are not resolved by the 5 m terrain: check the ellipse with 1 m imagery (IM-2 Athena, 2025, ended in a 20 m crater).

reasons: No power data given: the battery must cover up to 130 h of darkness
not_evaluated: rock and crater size inside the ellipse (needs 1 m imagery hazard maps)
distance to other landers and infrastructure
